questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect narration of the given sentence.**

Priya told her mother, “I couldn’t get all the items you wanted today from the shop.”

options.text: Priya told to her mother that I couldn’t get all the items you wanted today from the shop.
Priya told her mother that she couldn’t get all the items I wanted that day from the shop.
Priya told her mother I couldn’t get all the items she wanted today from the shop.
Priya told her mother that she couldn’t get all the items she wanted that day from the shop.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Priya told her mother that she couldn’t get all the items she wanted that day from the shop.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the steps to change the sentence from direct to indirect speech:
 
• When the direct speech is in an assertive form, we follow the steps given below:
 
 
• Convert the sentence in the direct speech into assertive.
 
• The tense of reported speech is changed only when the reporting verb is in the past tense. 
 
• The reporting verb 'told' will remain the same.
 
• The connector 'that' will follow the removal of comma and inverted commas.​
 
• The personal pronouns will be changed according to the subject and object of the reporting verb.
 
• ​Here the 1st person 'I' will change into the 3rd person 'she' as per the object.
 
• The modal verb 'could not' will remain the same.
 
• Words showing time and place are changed accordingly. (today- that day)
 
 
 
• ​​At last line up the remaining part.

 

Following these steps, we get-* Priya told her mother that she couldn’t get all the items she wanted that day from the shop.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive voice of the given sentence.**

Raman heard a strange noise near the closed door.

options.text: A strange noise was hearing Raman near the closed door.
A strange noise will be heard near the closed door by Raman.
A strange noise is hear by Raman near the closed door.
A strange noise was heard near the closed door by Raman.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **A strange noise was heard near the closed door by Raman.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in an active voice form, hence we need to convert it into a passive voice form.
 
• Find the subject (Raman) and object (A strange noise) of the sentence and exchange their places. 
 
• The given sentence is in the simple past tense. The passive verb form for simple past is: 
 
 
• was/were + past participle form of the verb.
 
• So, 'heard' changes to 'was heard'.
 
 
 
• At last line up the remaining part.

 ​

Following these steps, we get - *A strange noise was heard near the closed door by Raman.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** *​​​​

 
• If the subject isn't clear, the agent (by + Sub.) needn't be mentioned in the passive voice.
 
• Example:
 
 
• *People follow this ritual all over the world. (active)*
 
• *This ritual is followed all over the world. (passive)*
